cues.text: Keep walking the paths you choose. We are KneeUp.
Zhiyuan, sixty-two, is a fictional demonstration character who wants to keep hiking familiar trails.
We focus on independently mobile adults aged sixty to seventy-five.
This is the team's existing footage of the real prototype.
EMG electrodes on the leg connect to the controller and pump test bench.
Live integration between this website and the hardware still needs on-site verification.
The air-cell samples show our exploration of manufacturing methods.
This footage does not validate assistance effects. A control level is not air pressure.
KneeUp connects a pneumatic brace, sensing records and AI observations.
The current website and AI do not send pump-control commands.
Now, see how a movement record is created.
Today's task follows a team demonstration script, using synthetic EMG data.
Camera and EMG inputs each retain their own source labels.
Once recording begins, data and events enter the same session.
This software demonstration uses synthetic data to test the workflow.
Missing measurements stay not measured. We now manually mark a voluntary end.
This view shows the current analysis status.
External AI is not configured. Only local rule explanations appear below.
Model observations and references remain empty. No model answer is fabricated.
Existing rule explanations retain their input window and data sources.
Switch to the professional view, inspect the same record, and mark it reviewed.
Back in the user view, this confirmation still belongs to the original session.
The demonstration switches roles on the same computer.
Every observation should have a source.
The voluntary end is manually annotated. A person must explain the reason.
The system does not infer fatigue from this event alone.
Existing smart knee braces already connect users with professional services.
We need to validate how much assistance pneumatics provide, and how much wearing burden they add.
We are seeking one organisation and one professional lead.
We propose a four-week user-experience pilot with ten participants.
Pneumatic-assistance effects need separate validation. Recruitment has not begun.
KneeUp. Keep walking the paths you choose.
